info.title: Daily Ops Last Mile Dashboard
info.description: Live nationwide operations dashboard for Ninja Van Malaysia's last-mile fleet team (143 stations across Southern, Northern, Klang Valley, East Coast and East Malaysia -- East Malaysia is Retail, not Last Mile, so it can be toggled out of every view). Pulls parcel- and route-level data from Redash every 15 minutes and shows it per region, zone, station and driver: Action Board (SLA heatmap), Shipment Details (fresh unscan, latlong, scan-in duration buckets and an hourly timing chart), Station Health (in-hub, 0-attempt, on-hold, aging, missing, pending ATS, COD%), Route Monitoring (routed, attendance, OVFD, success and completion rates by driver type, old routes, pending-in-yesterday-route, completion summary), Aging Details, RPU, Recovery (missing parcels), Shipper Radar (Zalora, Amway, Watson, Orca, Sodaxpress SLAs; Restock NXD bundles, on-hold / incomplete MPS bundles; B2B RDO document compliance), Cold Chain and Urgent TN (track tracking numbers and assign them to a PIC with in-progress / closed status and notifications), DoD (Station Health day by day), a Task List (follow-ups, to-dos, assigned tasks) and a KPI page (Beta) with the weekly results, the OPEX result and RCA / analysis for Hybrid Productivity, Invalid POD, COD RTS, Prior, Completion D0 / D3, Terminal T7 and FIFO D0, judged against KPI targets per region that an admin sets. Every count opens its tracking numbers, with CSV export. Access is role-based (admin, manager, region, station) with multi-value region/zone/station scopes enforced in the backend. Users can send feedback (with an attachment) that admins reply to and close. For Fleet Managers and their regional and station teams. Every /api route answers for the signed-in user (Google SSO: the platform adds X-Forwarded-Email) and is limited to that user's role and region / zone / station scope.

Attempts and invalid POD per day for a region, zone, station or driver (level). Without `keys` the `top` entities with the most
invalid POD are drawn; `options` lists what can be picked. `__all__` is everything in view.

get.summary: The weekly LM POD Performance view (zones, stations, drivers, OPS routes on the final result after the audit); managers and admins only.
Weekly KPI results by region / zone / station from the uploaded Dashboard WoW sheet, with every KPI's target (per-region targets included), limited to the caller's scope.

get.description:
The uploaded OPEX result: the OPEX dashboard's own CSV gets a structured view (`opex`); any other table is shown as it is
(columns + up to 5,000 rows). Open to every user -- no scope filter.

get.description:
Hybrid Productivity data for the KPI Dashboard, scoped to what the viewer may see. `refresh` (admins / managers) skips the
Metabase cache. Each of the datasets comes from an uploaded file if there is one, otherwise from Metabase.

get.summary: Liveness check used by the platform to confirm the backend container is up.
Return the signed-in user's identity and role/scope, derived from the SSO-injected X-Forwarded-Email header.
Return the latest station metrics snapshot, filtered to the caller's role scope, with zone and region rollups.
DoD dashboard: one Station Health snapshot per station per day for this week and last week, limited to the caller's scope.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's metric count, for the UI's click-a-number drill-down. Served from an in-memory cache built by the last refresh.
get.description:
Tracking numbers behind one station's metric count, for the UI's click-to-see-TNs
panel. Served from the in-memory cache built by the last refresh -- empty right
after a restart until the next hourly (or manual) refresh runs.

get.summary: Return the latest Shipment Details snapshot (Total Fresh/Shipment, Fresh Unscan, Latlong, Fresh Attempt %, LH trip timings), scoped to the caller.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Fresh Unscan or Latlong count.
Return the latest Routed View snapshot (Total Routed/Attendance/OVFD/Success/COD%/Success Rate/Completion Rate) at station/zone/region level, plus a driver-level breakdown, scoped to the caller.
Return the latest Shipper Watch snapshot (Amway/Watson/Orca hypercare, Zalora NXD, Restock NXD), scoped to the caller.
Return the tracking numbers behind one station's Shipper Watch metric count.
Return the latest Aging Details snapshot (station x age-bucket pivot, plus TN-level rows) for one of 5 sub-views, scoped to the caller.
Cold Chain shipper: tracking numbers in aging buckets per station / zone / region, limited to the caller's scope.
Restock NXD bundles (all, or only those needing attention) per station, limited to the caller's scope.
Return the latest Old Route snapshot -- tracking numbers still stuck on their original Route ID/date (query 1451) -- at region/zone/station/driver level, scoped to the caller.
B2B document compliance (RDO so far) counts per station and status, limited to the caller's scope.
Every RDO tracking number behind one station row's count, with bundle details, uncapped, for the click-a-number modal and CSV export.
get.description:
Every RDO tracking number behind one station row's count (all of them --
unlike the main table this isn't capped), with the bundle details, for the
click-a-number modal and its CSV export. status: 'all' (Total TN) or one of
the per-status columns.

get.summary: Return the latest RPU snapshot (query 1397). The station/zone/region summary always breaks out every stage as its own column; the `stage` filter only narrows the tn_rows list, scoped to the caller.
Return the latest RPU Aging snapshot (station x age-bucket pivot, same scheme as Aging Details) for Overall or 0-Attempt, optionally filtered to one shipper.
Recovery tab's Missing Details: region/zone/station overview + TN list from query 1297, with high-value highlighting.
Recovery -> Active Missing: the open missing tickets in the caller's access (Ship Out and B2B left out) with what stations answered about each.
get.description:
Recovery -> Active Missing (kind=parcel): the open missing tickets in the caller's access (Ship Out and B2B documents left out) with what stations answered about each.
kind=b2b: the B2B documents only (MYRDO / MYPSO / -DO), the "B2B Document Active Missing" sub-tab.

get.summary: Lists all submitted app feedback. Admin only.
get.description:
Admins get everyone's feedback; anyone else gets only their own. Opening the
list as the sender clears the "new reply" flag (drives the header bell).

schema.title: Response List Feedback Api Feedback Get

get.summary: Download a feedback item's attachment (its author or an admin).

patch.summary: Admin only: reply to a feedback item and / or change its status.

delete.description:
The sender removes their own feedback -- it disappears for the admins too,
whatever its status (2026-09-25 feedback), attachment included.

get.summary: The Urgent TN rows the caller added or was assigned, with each tracking number's health details.

post.summary: Add an Urgent TN row and assign a PIC (rings the PIC's bell).
"Got it" on the owner reminder banner: quiet it until the next 10am / 2pm / 5pm slot.
post.description: "Got it" on the owner reminder banner: quiet it until the next 10am / 2pm / 5pm slot.

get.summary: Dashboard users matching what is typed in the Urgent TN PIC box (2+ characters, 8 results, never the caller).
get.description:
Dashboard users matching what's typed in the Urgent TN PIC box (2026-09-25 feedback).
Any signed-in user can call it, since anyone may pick a PIC -- so it is kept narrow: 2+
characters, 8 results at most, never the caller, and only email / name / role are returned
(no scope, no last-seen).

schema.title: Response Urgent Pic Suggestions Api Urgent Tn Pic Suggestions Get

patch.summary: Update an Urgent TN row: status, note, PIC reply or acknowledgement.

delete.summary: Remove an Urgent TN row (also for its PIC).

post.summary: Remove several of the caller's own Urgent TN rows at once.
post.description:
Remove several of your own items at once (2026-09-25 feedback). Like a single remove it deletes
them for their PICs too; anything in the list that you didn't add is left alone and counted.

post.summary: Opening the Urgent TN tab: drops the NEW marker for the PIC and clears the owner's "PIC updated" flag.
post.description:
Opening the Urgent TN tab: drops the NEW marker for the PIC and clears the
owner's "PIC updated" flag. It does NOT silence the PIC's bell -- only picking
a status does (see urgent_tn_update).

get.summary: Counts behind the Urgent TN bell, the owner reminder and the Feedback badge.
get.description:
Counts behind the Urgent TN tab's bell and the Admin/Feedback badge.
urgent_notify: items assigned to me by someone else that are still in progress and
either never acknowledged or last acknowledged over an hour ago -- only between 08:00 and
20:00 Malaysia time, so nothing rings overnight.
urgent_owner_reminder: how many tracking numbers I added are still open, while the 10am / 2pm / 5pm
reminder is ringing (until I press Got it).
urgent_owner_updates: items I added where the PIC replied / changed the status.

get.summary: Admin only: who uploaded the driver / rider details CSV last, when, and how many rows.

post.summary: Admin only: upload the driver / rider details CSV that gives Route Monitoring its Tenure column.

get.summary: List all users provisioned for the dashboard, with their role and scope. Admin only.

schema.title: Response List Users Api Admin Users Get

post.summary: Provision a new user with a role and access scope (all / region / zone / station). Managers can only grant Station staff or Region staff roles (never Admin or "sees everything" scope); Region staff can only grant the Station staff role with station-level access.

Add several teammates at once, each with their own role and scope (Admin, Manager, or Region staff). Managers can only grant Station staff or Region staff roles (never Admin or "sees everything" scope); Region staff can only grant the Station staff role with station-level access.

patch.summary: Update an existing user's role, scope, or display name. Admin only.

delete.summary: Remove a user's access to the dashboard. Admin only; an admin cannot remove their own access.
